verdicts.reason: A is mostly a shrunken copy of the original. The headline wraps so that 'Yet' sits alone on its own line, the content is packed into the top 45% of the canvas with dead space under it, and the logo sun icon looks squashed. B fills the tall format with a cleaner two-line headline break and a larger CTA. Its flaws: the gaps between blocks are uneven and too large (headline to body, body to CTA), the orange divider was moved above the eyebrow line, and the legal text is unreadably small and crowded right under the CTA.
